functional_source_assessment.scope: Exact four-source v5 candidate and unchanged review-matrix support. functional_source_assessment.assessment: The focused v5 change rejects the exact Python script token '-' before journal mutation or child dispatch while retaining ./- as a directly pinned script path and literal '-' after a script as a script argument. The accepted source contract is otherwise met: recognized interpreter identities use closed startup forms, Python requires both isolation and -S, Bash requires -p, selected scripts are directly pinned regular non-symlink files, child stdin is DEVNULL, and original guarded-driver arguments are bound exactly. Policy/review/candidate pins, action phase and argv, bounded append-only journal state, deadline accounting, process-group cleanup, and post-success pin checks were reviewed in the complete source. Documentation accurately limits the guard to its pinned inputs and known entrypoints and does not claim dependency discovery, containment, or tamperproof journaling.
